# monotoneplugin — MONOTONE

**MONOTONE** (`.mon`), Jim "Trixter" Leonard / Hornet's PC-speaker tracker — up
to a dozen square-wave tracks summed into the IBM PC's single 1-bit beeper.

Extensions: `.mon`

The mixing wraps the PTPlayer-style channel model; the output is a 1-bit speaker
sampled to PCM, as in [bbsongplugin](../bbsongplugin/README.md).

Note: `.mon` is also a UADE extension (Legless Music Editor); routing is by
content and by plugin priority.
